product_brief: Industry’s most advanced HSM adapter for cloud encryption, key management, and authentication with high performance and scalability.
pqc_capability_description: The LS2 hardware can be certified and updated in the field to support new algorithms and variants, such as post-quantum cryptography, providing cryptographic agility and future-proofing the HSM against new vulnerabilities.
key_management_model: Hardware-secured storage of up to one million keys; secure key generation and management within a FIPS-certified security boundary.
fips_validated: FIPS 140-2 Level 2 and 3 certified; FIPS 140-3 pending/anticipated certification.
primary_platforms: Cloud (HSM-as-a-Service), Data Centers, Network Appliance OEMs
target_industries: Payment, Privacy Compliance, General Purpose, Banks, Retailers, Media Companies, Governments
regulatory_status: FIPS 140-2 Level 2/3, FIPS 140-3 (pending), Common Criteria (CC), eIDAS, PCI PTS HSM 4.0
pqc_roadmap_details: Hardware can be updated in the field to support post-quantum cryptography algorithms and variants.
financial_&_business_impact: Lowest cost per key stored, per partition; lowest total cost of ownership (TCO); pay-as-you-go model.
